subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

The interviewee tackled the questions of the interviewer with substantial **__aplomb__**.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Self-assurance."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"aplomb"** means self-assurance or confidence in a difficult situation. (किसी कठिन परिस्थिति में आत्म-आश्वासन या आत्मविश्वास)

 
 
• **Example:** *She handled the unexpected crisis with **aplomb**__, showing great self-assurance and composure.*
 
 
 
• **"Self-assurance"** means confidence in one's own abilities or character. (किसी की अपनी क्षमताओं या चरित्र पर विश्वास)
 __
 
• **Example:** *She's an extrovert who exudes **self-assurance**__.*
 
 
 
• ​Therefore,* *the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word is **"Self-assurance."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Camaraderie"** means a feeling of friendship and mutual trust among a group of people. It is not a synonym of "aplomb."
 
• **"Hostility"** means unfriendliness or opposition towards someone or something. It is the opposite of "aplomb."
 
• **"Sanctity"** means the state of being holy, sacred, or inviolable. It is not a synonym of "aplomb."

73:Taae,

The correct answer is** "Imbecility."**
